description: This file defines the 'ItemService' interface for item-related operations in the billing software, including methods for adding items with file upload, fetching items, and deleting items.

classes.name: ItemService
classes.description: Interface defining item management operations such as adding, fetching, and deleting items.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a new item based on the provided request data and associated file, may throw IOException.

methods.name: fetchItems
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all items.

methods.name: deleteItem
methods.description: Deletes an item identified by the given item ID.
